messages:
laura: quick heads-up — hit OOM during an incremental backfill of raw safetensors into the shared cache. sketching a tiny backfill shim to avoid a full manifest rewrite and still satisfy loader's index-first checks.

laura: problem: some checkpoints are raw safetensors shards (no sidecar index). loader expects an index/manifest for streaming/hotstart; without it we either build the full in-memory index (OOM) or do many slow range reads.

sam: paste the failure? parsing OOM or write-time? :thinking_face:

laura: parsing + header assembly. sample: "ERROR: shard-17 parse OOM at parse_tensor_headers() alloc 1.2GB for header_map"

nate: two quick ideas: (1) synthesize a tiny on-disk manifest with only per-tensor offsets+checksums, (2) runtime accepts a streaming 'header stub' that has just what warmup needs (kv offsets, dtype/shape).

irene: header stubs sound right. warmup only needs offsets to prime KV cache. if backfill can atomically write a stub loader can fast-path. need atomic rename to avoid races.

mike: careful — legacy loaders sometimes verify a manifest hash. if we synthesize partial manifest, add a version tag so old code rejects it explicitly instead of failing checksum.

laura: proposal: backfill shim writes <shard>.stub.json with minimal fields: version, shard_index, offsets[], checksum, etag. atomic write: stub.tmp -> fsync -> rename to stub.json. loader accepts stub if present and verifies etag before trusting. example stub (as a string): '{"version":"0.1","shard":17,"offsets":[0,128,10240],"checksum":"sha256:abcd","etag":"s3-etag-123"}'

anya: when to synthesize vs full index? tradeoff: synthesize for large shards or high-latency stores and schedule full manifest async; GC stubs when complete.

sam: alternative: streaming parser that writes offsets to disk as it scans (O(1) memory). fallback to stub after X MB of memory/parsing time. better since we eventually produce a real manifest.

nate: provenance: include upload-time nonce or object ETag in stub so loader can detect shard replacement; if mismatch, invalidate stub and refetch.

irene: +1. atomic overlay pattern and tombstone old stubs on replacement. document acceptance semantics in loader docs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/loader-stub-checks -> staging at 2026-03-25T03:00Z :rocket: (stub read logic only)

laura: UX: (1) surface stub vs manifest in catalog? (2) metrics for stub-path hit rate and latency delta?

anya: add catalog field 'index_state' with values ["indexed","stubbed","none"]. add per-route histogram tagged by index_state. console can show stub/backfill backlog.

mike: security: offsets aren't secrets but respect encryption markers. ensure stubs don't leak plaintext keys; add audit log entry when stub created.

laura: action items: Sam -> prototype streaming low-memory parser by EOW; Anya -> spec index_state + metrics; Nate -> implement ETag provenance checks; Irene -> atomic write pattern in loader docs. I'll PoC stub writer (S3 + local FS).

laura: want to avoid a large refactor but unblock hotstarts. I'll open a short RFC with the decisions later today unless objections. :+1:
